The nine survivors were then run against RELATED at 1000 as two combined mutants (`PLAT_FUZZ_RUNS=1000 vitest related --run --maxWorkers=1 packages/layout/src/infill/bentCutFabric.ts`, one mirror each). KA = K07 + K10 + K11 + K12 (the abandon path): exit 0, `Test Files 67 passed (67)`, `Tests 507 passed (507)`. KB = K03 + K06 + K08 + K09 + K13 (the re-location's guards): exit 0, the same 67 / 507. Both survive (CONFIRMED). Combining mutants is sound here because every member acts only on a path that no honest input reaches (below).

Why no survivor is a blocker:

* Each survivor acts only on a path that no honest input reached. Across the bench's 1 000 whole districts, the seat's
  1 000-district instrumented scan at seed 1, its 460-district scan at seed 2 and 100 two-district runs
  (`twoDistricts`, seeds 1 – 25 × prosperity 0.1 / 0.3 / 0.6 / 0.9), there were 0 'end-rows' refusals, 0 abandonments
  and 0 ring-check failures.
* Where such a path is reached, the code does what C-0243 states. For K03 this rests on reading: `tryCandidate` marks
  'end-rows' `touched` the same way it marks 'floor'. For the abandon path it rests on the forced probes A1 / A2:
  typed `E_INVARIANT`, no throw, no commit, digests unchanged.
* Under J202 / N-45 a further test of an unreached, already fail-safe path is a hardening KI row, not a fail. A
  survivor whose mutation cannot change any reachable output is equivalent on the domain and needs only its one-line
  note.
